title.narrative: Increased institutional, technical, representational and policy impact capacities of workers's organizations

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Documentation of good practices on internal governance, organizational models and digital engagement of workers’ organizations, including with respect to advocacy and communication (2) Development and dissemination of new and existing packages of knowledge products and tools (for example, policy briefs; digital tools; training manuals and virtual/blended training courses including in cooperation with the Turin Centre) on specific policy areas. (3) Development and dissemination of specific knowledge products and tools on policy coordination and coherence. (4) Identification and delivery of training of trainers programmes on priority policy areas including in cooperation with the Turin Centre. (5) Documentation of processes and policy results that have been influenced by workers’ organizations at all levels.
